parsed.note_claim: Congress explicitly granted the executive branch the authority to designate, extend, or terminate Temporary Protected Status (TPS) under 8 U.S. Code § 1254a
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: The Attorney General , after consultation with appropriate agencies of the Government, may designate any foreign state (or any part of such foreign state) under this subsection
parsed.reason: The statute text explicitly authorizes the Attorney General (executive branch) to designate foreign states for TPS under this code section.
